Pricing.faqCostA: Plans start at $15 USD/month. We scale the final price to your search volume and agree on it during the call.
Pricing.faqFeesQ: Are there setup fees or per-user charges?
Pricing.faqFeesA: No. We don't charge setup fees or per user. You pay for the leads you actually search for.
Pricing.faqVolumeQ: How many leads does a plan cover?
Pricing.faqVolumeA: Each lead uses 2 credits. With 500 credits, you can get up to 250 leads. Pain point analysis adds 0.5 credits per analyzed lead.
Pricing.faqIncludedA: Google Maps business search by industry and area, a results spreadsheet, pain point analysis, private history, CSV and XLSX export, and direct support.
Pricing.faqContractA: Schedule a WhatsApp call, tell us your monthly volume, and we'll put together a plan.
